purpose: Development design-validity screen; not BCA efficacy or held-out confirmation
authorization: User 2026-10-28: okay then lets apply fixes and do next gate
supersedes_for_this_gate_only: v3 execution hold; prior training holds and attempts remain unchanged

region.action_rule: float32 executed actions promoted to float64 before band arithmetic
region.load_rule: float32 observation coordinates 10 and 11 separately promoted to float64 then added

support.standardization: original training physical observations, population mean/std in float64; std<1e-12 replaced by1
support.tie_order: distance then original source row ID

controls.random_rule: same retained count as hole in each stratum, sampled once without replacement
controls.calibration: same hole-excluding calibration rows for all three prospective training conditions
controls.state_balance: hole versus random physical-coordinate mean difference divided by original training std
controls.reward_successor_balance: descriptive only; changed labels are consequences of action removal

data.calibration_episodes: first128 tuning-validation groups sorted by group ID
data.probe_episodes: first64 of remaining128 development-consumed tuning-validation groups sorted by group ID
data.free_policy_episodes: first16 of the same64 probe episode start seeds
data.freshness: All decoded roles already used in development; reused starts are not fresh confirmation

calibration.rule: keep each original selected row if outside hole; otherwise uniformly choose one eligible row in the same episode, using replacement RNG in sorted group order
calibration.interpretation: few removed rows are exposure accounting, not conditional coverage evidence; no new calibration guarantee

reference.state: reconstruct exact float64 state by replaying recorded prefix from original episode seed; assert every float32 observation matches
reference.continuation: candidate first action, then same frozen deterministic current actor; discount exponent0 at query; no terminal bootstrap
reference.other_action_coordinates: same frozen actor coordinates1:4 in all six candidates
reference.parity: 100 environment steps plus direct comparisons at t0,25,50,99; no private time mutation

decision.within_band_spread: max-min of the two interior edges and center, descriptive only
decision.primary_gate: all integrity, coverage, balance, center/flank value-gap and free actor-exposure criteria pass
decision.geometry_failure: record failed gate but finish this fixed value/exposure batch; never rescue or launch training
decision.failure: shelve this exact region for the proposed policy-efficacy design; no band/radius/threshold changes or automatic rerun
decision.pass: eligible for a separate reviewed training specification only; missing-label causal effect and BCA benefit remain untested

later_training_requirements_not_authoriz.reuse: support_shift_pilot_v1/runtime.py branch(context,warmup,arm,coefficient) at10k; extend in a new version only
later_training_requirements_not_authoriz.seed_values: must be separately collision-audited and frozen before training; none allocated by this gate
later_training_requirements_not_authoriz.primary: at20k, high-load band own-policy MAE improvement native_q versus BCA_q_minus_3U, hole minus state-stratified random-removal interaction, paired by training seed
later_training_requirements_not_authoriz.exploratory_rule: improvement>=1.0return in each of3 independent seeds; not a significance or precision guarantee
later_training_requirements_not_authoriz.controls: full replay with shared hole-excluding calibration; native, original BCA kappa3, existing training-gradient-strength-matched distance control
separate_panels: separately trained native versus BCA critics

rationales.radius: retain reviewed0.5 RMS setting; not enlarged from Gaussian approximation or observed pass rates
rationales.support: 32rows/8episodes and64cap retain reviewed neighborhood requirement;2 independent episodes per action band prevent single-episode evidence;80percent is a declared development adequacy hurdle, not a probability guarantee
rationales.global_coverage: 128rows/32episodes,8 per timebin and32 per loaddepth prevent an aggregate hiding tiny strata; engineering thresholds, not fitted from counts
rationales.balance: 0.1 original SD is a declared small mean-imbalance tolerance; it does not establish equal state distributions
rationales.value: 1.0 cumulative return is a declared practical resolution, over20times the analytic immediate-reward band bound; not a known full-Q separation
rationales.exposure: at least1percent high-load entry and2 episodes excludes an isolated incidental visit; not an estimator of learned-policy gain
rationales.stop_scope: Components answer different questions and finish once under the same cap; a failed geometry criterion stays failed regardless of later values
